input.summary: Change governing law from Arizona to New York and add exclusive New York County venue; seat any arbitration in New York County.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved governing law from Arizona to New York and added exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, which is our standard position; Delaware, California, or England and Wales (London courts) are acceptable alternatives. We have also seated any arbitration in New York County so the dispute forum matches the governing law.

ops.oldText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
ops.newText: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof, and each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com)
ops.newText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration seated in New York County, New York pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com)
